#### Help

# The X Subscription FAQ

## What is The X Subscription?

One plan for Cursor, Grok, and X benefits. See [What is The X Subscription](/x-subscription/overview).

## Do I have to switch?

No. Your current plan keeps working unless you change or cancel it. See [Do I have to switch](/x-subscription/do-i-have-to-switch).

## How do I switch?

Start at [cursor.com/unify](https://cursor.com/unify) if you pay for Cursor, or [accounts.x.ai/unify](https://accounts.x.ai/unify) if you're starting from Grok or X. See [How to unify](/x-subscription/unify-accounts).

## What happens to my old subscriptions?

See [Invoices & Refunds](/x-subscription/invoices-and-refunds).

## How much does it cost?

See [Pricing](/x-subscription/pricing).

## What if I'm having issues?

Contact support from settings.
